_: ⭐⭐ RS RATING L1b / L6b (2026-11-14) — OTHER-SYMBOL SPELLINGS THAT ARE SERVED ONLY BEHIND A CAPTURE WITNESS. Each key is the spelling a script writes (`request.security("SP:SPX", …)`; a seed as `request.seed(source, symbol, …)` spells `<SOURCE>:<SYMBOL>`, upper-cased). `store` is the key our bars route serves it under (`/api/bars/<store>`), `timeframes` the chart timeframes the witness covers, `queue_row` / `probe` the capture that settles it, `alignment` how the witness places the series' bars on a chart's bars (`otherSymbols.js::WITNESS_ALIGNMENTS`). ⛔ A ROW SERVES ONLY WHEN IT CARRIES `witness` (the capture) AND `captured` (its date) — the rule `symbolScope.json::confirmed` keeps: a row without a witness is an assertion wearing a data structure. Without them the spelling is refused BY NAME, citing its queue row (`otherSymbols.js::staticallyUnservable`, the one gate both lanes ask). Turning a row on is ONE data edit. ⭐ The `seed` rows are the frontend's manifest of `api/services/pine_seed_store.py::SEEDS`; `tests/test_pine_seed_manifest.py` rails that the two agree. ⭐⭐ RS RATING L11 (2026-11-17) — a chart timeframe with a block of its own (`periods.<tf>`) is served from the series HELD at another timeframe (`held`; fetched and cached under `<store>@<held>`, `otherSymbols.js::heldFetchOf`) and read per request timeframe as its capture witnessed (`reads`: `period` = the chart's own timeframe, a FOLD; `D` = a daily read below the chart, the row's daily read SAMPLED per chart bar; `otherSymbols.js::WITNESS_PERIOD_READS`). A block serves only with its own `witness` + `captured`; a timeframe listed in `timeframes` with no block is the row's own (`alignment`). ⭐⭐ T4 E2 (2026-11-22) — rows of `kind: "event"` (one per family: earnings, dividends, splits) are NOT spellings: no symbol string reads them (`otherSymbols.js::witnessRowsOf` skips them). They witness where TradingView places the chart's OWN corporate events (`request.earnings` / `request.dividends` / `request.splits`, rewritten at parse, `pine.js::eventAsSecurity`), fetched from `/api/pine/events/<chart symbol>` and placed by `placement` (`pineEvents.js::placeEvents`) on the `timeframes` listed; a row serves only with `witness` + `captured`.

EVENTS:SPLITS.how: TradingView's request.splits on NASDAQ:AAPL, NYSE:GE, NASDAQ:NVDA, NASDAQ:TSLA 1D and NVDA 1W: each event stamped at its date's session close; lookahead_on reads it on the first bar closing at or after that instant (the event's own bar), lookahead_off on the first bar opening after it (the next session on 1D, the next week on 1W); an event dated on a non-session day lands both reads on the next session (R1, 1,603 of 1,606 events across the three families, the 3 others that named exception). gaps_on: the value on that bar, na on every other; gaps_off: carried from it, na before the first event (R2, 0 mismatching bars). Monthly (W-E2, 2026-11-22, NASDAQ:AAPL and NYSE:JPM 1M): the same R1 and R2 over each month's first and last session (lookahead_on on the event's own month, lookahead_off on the next). Intraday needs a report's time of day, which UCT does not hold.
